diagnosis: The customer is requesting a replay of missed webhook events from a specific time window yesterday. Per policy, escalation is not required for this request type; the agent should guide the user to the manual replay feature available in the dashboard.
reply:
Hello,

Regarding the webhook events you missed between 14:00 and 15:00 yesterday, our system automatically retries failed deliveries six times over approximately one hour. If delivery is still unsuccessful after these attempts, the events remain available for manual replay for seven days.

You can manually replay these specific events directly from your dashboard. For more details on how this process works, please refer to our article on Webhook delivery failures and replay.

Let us know if you need further assistance locating the replay controls.

Best regards,
Support Team
